text:
karan: FYI CVE roundup: kubelet CVE-2025-12345 (privilege escalation), etcd CVE-2025-23456 (RCE via client auth), nginx-ingress CVE-2025-34567 (path traversal). Cert-manager released 1.12.0 with an API/CRD change that affects our helm values. Need triage + patch plan for prod clusters (us-east, eu-west).

sam: On it. Any severity / exploitability notes? Can we prioritize etcd first?

karan: etcd has a public PoC and is high exploitability. Recommend: patch etcd + restart in small batch first (canary), then kubelet (priv esc) as rolling restart with kernel patches where needed. Ingress is medium given our current ingress rules. Cert-manager needs more care due to CRD rename -> migration job required.

alex: For cert-manager migration: main impact is the `CertificateRequest` API group rename. I have a migration job that maps the old CRs to the new group. Suggest steps: apply CRD v1, run migration job (batch), validate, then upgrade helm chart. Also update RBAC: controller needs `clusterissuers/status` and `certificaterequests/finalizers` patch perms.

maria: KMS note: cert-manager stores keys in Secrets; with envelope encryption + KMS we must ensure the service account used for the migration has decrypt/verify on the new key version. I'll open a KMS policy PR against infra. Also recommend enabling audit logging for `secrets` write/create events for the 24h window during migration.

jenni: Customer impact? Any Dedicated/private clusters needing advance notices?

karan: Dedicated list: acme-inc, beta-ops, region-private-eu. Ops to schedule maintenance windows. @sam can you own canary for staging->canary->prod? @maria please draft KMS policy PR and add the key perms.

sam: Yep. Proposed schedule: staging pod-level canary tonight 22:00 UTC -> canary eu-west tomorrow 03:00 UTC -> remaining clusters over next 48h. Will do rolling drains and kubelet restarts with `--skip-eviction=false`.

sam: ```
# canary steps (example)
kubectl cordon node-123
kubectl drain node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
systemctl restart kubelet
helm upgrade --install cert-manager jetstack/cert-manager -f values.yaml --version 1.12.0
```

deploy-bot: deploy job `cluster-patch/etcd-1965432100` queued for canary eu-west. See https://ci.redwood.co/jobs/1965

alex: RBAC delta (minimal ClusterRole snippet):
```yaml
kind: ClusterRole
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: cert-manager-controller-minimal
rules:
- apiGroups: ["cert-manager.io"]
  resources: ["issuers","clusterissuers","certificaterequests"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","create","update","patch","delete"]
- apiGroups: ["" ]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get","create","update","delete"]
```

maria: Audit logging: I'll enable `audit.k8s.io/v1` policy for 72h and ship to Splunk index `k8s-audit`. Also adding an alert for `secrets` write spikes and `cert-manager` error-rate > 5% in 5m.

karan: Action items: sam (canary + rollout), maria (KMS PR + audit policy), alex (cert-manager migration script + RBAC PR), jenni (customer comms). Ping back with scheduled times and PR links. :thumbsup:

jenni: I'll prepare a comms draft and schedule for Monday 09:00 PST. What are the acceptance criteria for rollout?

karan: Acceptance: etcd cluster health OK for 2 full election intervals, kubelet restarts not increasing pod restart rate > 1% and average API latency within baseline (+300ms), cert-manager logs show no `unexpected API` errors for 6h post-upgrade. If any of the above fail, pause and run rollback playbook.

sam: Acknowledged, starting runbook preparation now. Will post canary logs to thread when done.
